title: Who owns the GPU driver?

scenes.heading: Who owns the GPU driver?
scenes.sub: Suppose GKE already provides the stack
voice: On GKE, find out who installs the driver and advertises GPUs before deploying a stack.
The AICR configuration profile makes those ownership choices explicit.

scenes.heading: Keep GKE in charge
voice: The default GKE profile expects the platform to manage the driver and its device plugin.
The resolved settings preserve that ownership of the GPU stack.

scenes.heading: Choose an alternative profile
voice: With compatible pools, bundle installer uses the driver installer supplied by the bundle.
The experimental DRA profile uses that pool shape and shifts whole GPU advertising to the NVIDIA DRA driver.

scenes.heading: Check the choice before deployment
scenes.sub: Match the profile to the pool you have
scenes.detail: Evaluate against the actual GPU pools
voice: Check the selected profile against the actual pool settings and metadata.
Generate the matching bundle, then let your deployment tooling apply the parts chosen for that ownership model.

payoff: Choose a GKE GPU stack profile by identifying who provides the driver and who advertises whole GPUs.
